items.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-balance
items.repackNote: Drops the 价格设置 settings section and its now-unreachable implementation: its balancePrices/balanceModels/refreshBalance bridge is retired by ADR 0006, so the section could only ever render a misleading "桥接不可用" error. The composer dock is unchanged.

items.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-conversation-tweaks
items.repackNote: conversation-tweaks: 0.2.x 退役了 dsh-settings 的 settingsNamespace/installSettingsSection 具名导出与 settingsScope 服务，并把设置表单改为由导出的 Config schema 派生（需 volatile() 标记）。本补丁补齐三处：自包含垫片、createSettingsScope 重建读写面、客户端运行时探测。

items.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-openclaw-bridge
items.repackNote: openclaw-bridge: settingsNamespace/installSettingsSection 具名导出与 settingsScope 服务在 0.2.x 均退役，且设置表单改由 Config schema 派生。本补丁补齐三处；桥接路由与微信区块不受影响。

items.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-prompt-custom
items.repackNote: prompt-custom: 同族的 settingsNamespace/installSettingsSection/settingsScope 退役，外加 PERSONA_SECTION/PERSONA_ORDER 改名为 PREFIX/SUFFIX。本补丁四类改动一并适配，保持原有分段顺序。

items.name: computer-user
items.repackNote: Expose Config on the default export (the loader unwraps to default, so a named export alone is dropped), mark its fields volatile, and swap the retired settingsScope inject for a dual-generation configForms probe. Upstream 0.3.7 is maintained but targets the 0.1.3 kernel; drop these patches once it ships a 0.2.x release.

items.name: dsh-better-sidebar
items.repackNote: better-sidebar: 0.2.x 移除了 settingsNamespace 具名导出与 ctx.settings.register（改指自包含垫片重建 scope）；另补 conversation.chat.turnTail 的 options.id —— 它是 list slot，0.2.x 缺 id 直接 throw，该槽位在界面上整体消失。

items.name: dsh-compact
items.repackNote: dsh-compact: settingsNamespace 具名导出与 settingsScope 服务在 0.2.x 均退役，ctx.settings.register 也不存在了。本补丁补齐三处并给 schema 标 volatile()。

items.name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
items.repackNote: Update-notice button contrast: pin light values (outline 1.10:1 -> 3.11:1, label 1.06:1 -> 4.95:1) on the dark glass card.

items.name: dsh-settings-groups
items.repackNote: General-settings collapser: real rows are the slot wrapper children, not the wrapper itself (the whole page used to be hidden as a single "advanced" row).
